description:
China could potentially shut down America’s power grid—and the threat may already be inside the equipment we rely on. In this episode of China Uncensored, we look at Chinese-made transformers, inverters, cyberattacks, Volt Typhoon, and the growing risks to America’s critical infrastructure. The scary part? Most people aren’t paying attention.
